title: SynthTabularDataGeneration-IR
summary: A research repository benchmarking synthetic tabular data generation and oversampling strategies for imbalanced regression tasks, comparing classical resampling, SMOTE variants, deep-learning generators, and the authors' own CARTGen-IR method. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and CopulaGANSynthesizer (via SingleTableMetadata) as generator baselines against which the proposed CART-based method is compared.
